verdict.rationale: Convex does not natively implement MFA or enterprise SSO; it delegates authentication to third-party providers like Clerk, Auth0, and WorkOS AuthKit (noted as 'built for B2B apps'), which can support SAML/OIDC, but Convex's own docs never describe configuring or requiring MFA/SAML/OIDC directly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of enforcing MFA, SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO configuration, or admin controls for requiring these on end users.
